strategyReview: The broad weekend HL funding reversion book is the main working system: 612 clean live trades at 69% wins and +0.18% avg, with 253 shadow trades at 74% wins and +0.99% avg. The Polymarket YES-overpricing edge also keeps validating: ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO live is 4/4, gated FIND-0020 shadows are 116/187 at +2.23% avg, and manual IV-touch rich-NO shadows are 9/10. The failures are concentrated in static single-asset weekend funding variants, PM proxy shorts, and contract-edge setups misgraded as spot-directional bets; the open book is small but currently has offsetting GOLD long spot vs GOLD short perp exposure that nets to noise.

failureClusters.evidence: CBRS 47% on 16/34, AAPL 48% on 13/27, MU 38% on 8/21. Losses repeatedly show funding moving deeper negative or oscillating after a simple < -10 trigger, not normalizing enough to deliver >2% spot in 2 days.
failureClusters.recommendation: Stop spending tests on static < -10 spot-move variants. Refinements must require weekend-only regime-relative panic plus a normalization inflection, or the family should be allowed to die.

failureClusters.theme: Polymarket proxy shorts on real funding/PC signals
failureClusters.evidence: FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG_PM_PROXY_SHORT is 3/24 shadow wins at avg -2.97%; PC_RATIO_EXTREME_LOW_PM_PROXY_SHORT is 1/18 at avg -6.19%. Live FUNDING_EXTREME_LONG is also slightly negative overall, with AMZN 29% and HYPE 33% win rates.
failureClusters.recommendation: Keep these proxy shadows blocked and do not promote them. The PM contract payoff is different from the perp short and the proxy is not capturing the intended edge.

failureClusters.theme: Contract edge misauthored as spot directional
failureClusters.evidence: GOLD one-touch cap-edge H-534 scores only 35% on scorable tests when graded on >2% spot decline, but its NO contract examples show positive contract premium decay. No-bias gap shadow likewise shows negative avg when forced into spot-move grading.
failureClusters.recommendation: Re-author these as contract P&L theses with neutral direction, days-to-expiry, edge, spread, and liquidity conditions. Do not forecast spot travel from premium edges.

failureClusters.evidence: cross_asset_iv_compression_vol_expansion is 9/25 at 36% win; btc_iv_compression_vol_reversion is 5/18 at 28% win. Most losses are small absolute moves under the exam threshold or late-stage confirmation failures.
failureClusters.recommendation: Treat both as low priority. Either require actual inflection such as a positive 24h PM IV change, or let current tests resolve and kill if win rates remain below base.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 16/34 scorable tests at 47% win. The static cbrs_hl_funding_ann < -10 trigger catches funding that continues to -33.6%, -98.5%, and -23.2% instead of normalizing, so the entry is not a timing trigger for a >2% CBRS spot move within 2 days.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A static cbrs_hl_funding_ann below -10% is a sufficient timing trigger for >2% CBRS spot move within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 13/27 scorable tests at 48% win. AAPL funding below -10% on any day frequently fails to normalize enough or produces no >2% spot follow-through, with several tests showing only 0.6% to 5.5% funding oscillation.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: AAPL funding below -10% on any day reliably normalizes and yields a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 8/21 scorable tests at 38% win. MU funding below -10% often continues lower or spikes only after missing the 2-day spot window; the single static threshold does not isolate true weekend funding panics.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single MU funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes and produces a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 8/23 scorable tests at 35% win, plus 7 unscorable tests. The contract P&L examples show NO premium decay working while the spot-decline prediction fails, confirming the signal is a contract edge, not a spot directional edge.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large gold underlying-cap edge on upside one-touch NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% GOLD spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 9/25 scorable tests at 36% win. HYPE risk-on participation confirms BTC trend after it is already extended, not before continuation; repeated losses come from BTC being near highs and rolling over despite stable HYPE OI.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above its 24h SMA with stable OI independently confirms durable BTC upside rather than late-stage FOMO/overextension.

hypothesisReviews.observation: 17% win over 6 completed tests before family aggregation. BTC PM IV z-score below -1.5 frequently precedes moves under the >2% absolute exam threshold, meaning the compression signal alone does not reliably produce a large snapback within 3 days.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: BTC PM IV below its 30-day mean by more than 1.5 standard deviations reliably leads to a >2% absolute spot move within 3 days.

journalEntry: Allocation follows the yield scoreboard: mined FIND-authored hypotheses have materially lower cost per survivor than refinements (53.1 vs 144 tests per survivor), so tonight is weighted toward panel NO-edge siblings, plus only mechanical refinements for the worst static weekend funding shadows. The GOLD one-touch family is re-authored as a contract premium fade because the spot-decline grading was invalid. Weekend funding entry is raised one increment from -0.50 to -0.45 based on weekend-clustered shadow evidence: shadow weekends are 3/3 positive with mean +83.82%, and the digest says 188/253 blocked trades would have won, suggesting the entry band is too strict on the margin. No signalRisk changes are made; payoff-shape evidence is not yet strong enough.
